description: ENEA describes ODESSE as a dynamic environment for assessing energy choices across multiple buildings. It combines a graphical interface, material information and preprocessing with hourly thermal and energy-demand simulation for retrofit feasibility studies. Resolution follows the buildings and input data. The official description does not establish current source-code licensing or validation of a particular retrofit proposal. Published by ENEA. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: Unknown; no data or software reuse licence established from the reviewed metadata. Cost or acquisition terms remain to be confirmed with the provider. Potential simulation uses include climate adaptation, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-energyplus. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
